$comment: Provenance for every image in this directory. Filenames describe what the image shows, NOT where it sat on the old site. Check `contexts` before placing one: an image is accurate only on the listed pages. `explicitlyNot` records pages where it would mislead.

recoveredFrom.note: All twelve pages are captured. Google's image CDN returns 403 to direct requests, so the archive is the sole source for the bytes. Each page's nested assets were written to a distinct Google URL, so the same picture appears under several ids; identical files are noted in `duplicatesOf`.

logo-tvu.png.describes: The organisation mark: a circular rainbow TVU with the Sawtooth ridgeline.

boise-skyline.png.describes: Boise skyline silhouette; inverted in CSS to sit on the dark footer.

logo-stevenson-real-estate.png.describes: Battle of Idaho sponsor. Teal serif wordmark.

logo-erth-beverage-co.png.describes: Battle of Idaho sponsor. Teal block wordmark.

logo-goldsteins-bagels.png.describes: A bagel shop shown on the old tournament page, not listed among the sponsors in the copy. Kept in case it is relevant.

boise-landscape-mark.png.describes: Line illustration of the Boise skyline beneath a hand and mountain. Used beside the Sawtooth text on the partner page.

cityscape-band.png.describes: The skyline portion of the boise-landscape-mark artwork, cropped to a wide band with the white background knocked out to alpha. Screened at low opacity across the foot of the footer.
cityscape-band.png.derivation: Cropped to the skyline and mountain band, then the near-white background was made transparent so only the black strokes remain. A vector trace was attempted first and abandoned as unusable; this is a raster knockout, so the strokes are the original recovered pixels.

action-lay.jpg.alt: A Sawtooth player diving for a disc.
action-lay.jpg.describes: A Sawtooth player fully extended, reaching for a disc in flight.

team-roster.jpg.alt: The Sawtooth roster posing on the field.
team-roster.jpg.describes: The full Sawtooth roster in blue and white, posing on grass.
team-roster.jpg.placedOnBoi: The Battle of Idaho page carries this as a portrait of the partner club the tournament supports, with a caption that says so explicitly. It is not presented as the tournament, the field, or a past edition. The original explicitlyNot entry is withdrawn deliberately, not by oversight.

team-huddle.jpg.alt: A club team huddled on the field.
team-huddle.jpg.describes: Players in numbered black jerseys standing in a tight huddle.

team-roster-boise.jpg.alt: The Sawtooth roster with the Boise foothills behind them.
team-roster-boise.jpg.describes: Sawtooth in white jerseys on a park field with the foothills and Owyhee-style ridges behind. The most place-specific image we have.

aerial-circle.jpg.alt: Overhead aerial of players standing in a circle.
aerial-circle.jpg.describes: Overhead drone shot of a circle of players on grass. Directly illustrates the aerial media services.

aerial-youth.jpg.alt: Overhead aerial of youth players forming letters on a field.
aerial-youth.jpg.describes: Aerial shot of a large group spelling out letters on a turf field. Youth-programme imagery.

youth-team-huddle.jpg.alt: A youth team huddled on the field.
youth-team-huddle.jpg.describes: A mixed group of young players and coaches in pink and blue jerseys, arms raised in a huddle on a winter field.

youth-coaching.jpg.alt: A coach instructing players during a stoppage in play.
youth-coaching.jpg.describes: A high-school-age player in a blue kit listening to instruction from teammates on the sideline. Directly illustrates the clinics programme.

action-lay-team-dues.jpg.alt: A Sawtooth player diving for a disc near the end zone.
action-lay-team-dues.jpg.describes: Same diving action shot as action-lay.jpg, published on the team-dues page.

aerial-tournament.jpg.alt: Aerial view of a large group arranged in an arc on a field.
aerial-tournament.jpg.describes: Wide aerial of a crowd in team colours arranged in an arc.

logo-tvu-roundel.png.describes: Circular TVU rainbow badge, alternative to the primary mark.

logo-sawtooth-mark.png.describes: Sawtooth mark with luminance converted to alpha, for dark grounds.

logo-sawtooth-400.png.describes: Sawtooth mark with luminance converted to alpha, for dark grounds.

logo-tvu-200.png.describes: Width-limited variant of the primary mark.

unrecovered.$comment: Assets that could not be downloaded. All five are decorative marks on the Sawtooth page.
unrecovered.note: None were essential; the Sawtooth page renders well without them.
